e.title: **把「用什么口径定价」做成一个参数，并另外给出破产概率**：一个 R 长寿风险包把年金定价分成**确定性**与**随机**两层，**而公平保费有两个口径**——**逐字「基于均值的（**精算中性**）」与「**基于分位数的**方法，**即把保费加载以在不利情景下保护保险人」**；**它另外单独给出**保险人破产概率****（**逐年模拟资金路径并判定破产，**返回以破产收场的模拟比例**）**；**⚠️ 而其 `LICENSE` 只有 **246 字节**、句子断在「**in the Software without restriction...**」，**而 README 与 `DESCRIPTION` 都写着 MIT**
e.title_en: Making the pricing basis a parameter and reporting ruin probability separately: an R longevity-risk package splits annuity valuation into a deterministic and a stochastic layer and offers two premium bases, one described verbatim as mean-based and actuarially neutral and the other as quantile-based, loading the premium to protect the insurer in adverse scenarios, while ruin probability is supplied on its own by simulating the fund path and returning the share of scenarios that end in insolvency — and its licence file measures only 246 bytes, stopping mid-sentence inside the permission grant, even though the readme and the package description both say MIT
e.title_hk: **把「用什麼口徑定價」做成一個參數，並另外給出破產概率**：一個 R 長壽風險包把年金定價分成**確定性**與**隨機**兩層，**而公平保費有兩個口徑**——**逐字「基於均值的（**精算中性**）」與「**基於分位數的**方法，**即把保費加載以在不利情景下保護保險人」**；**它另外單獨給出**保險人破產概率****（**逐年模擬資金路徑並判定破產，**返回以破產收場的模擬比例**）**；**⚠️ 而其 `LICENSE` 只有 **246 位元組**、句子斷在「**in the Software without restriction...**」，**而 README 與 `DESCRIPTION` 都寫著 MIT**
e.summary: 一个**R 长寿风险与年金分析包**（★0、仓库体量 18 KB、**实测 **17 个文件**）：**逐字自述为**「**Longevity Risk and Annuity Analysis Toolkit**」**，**并把使用者写成三类**（**精算师、保险分析师与养老基金管理人**）；**其最值得记的一处是它把**定价口径当成一个参数****——**逐字说明公平保费支持**「**基于均值的（**精算中性**）」方法**或**「**基于分位数的**方法，**即把保费加载以在不利情景下保护保险人」**；**第二处是它**单独给出破产概率****——**逐字说明 `ruin_probability()`「**逐年模拟保险人的资金路径（加上利息、减去按生存加权的支出）并标记无力偿付，**返回以破产收场的模拟情景比例」**；**第三处是它**把随机性放在最前面****——**逐字说明 `simulate_mortality()` 用**指数改善趋势（参数 `beta`）**并叠加**标准差为 `sigma` 的高斯冲击**，**产出 `n_years × n_sim` 的死亡率路径矩阵**；**⚠️ 而本词条实测其 `LICENSE` 只有 **246 字节、7 行**、正文断在「**in the Software without restriction...**」**——**⭐ 本词条**据此推断这正是 GitHub 许可字段报 **NOASSERTION** 的原因**（**⚠️ 该推断属本词条**），**并**如实指出：**README 与 `DESCRIPTION` 都写着 MIT****
e.summary_hk: 一個**R 長壽風險與年金分析包**（★0、體量 18 KB、**實測 17 個文件**）：**逐字自述為**「**Longevity Risk and Annuity Analysis Toolkit**」**，**並把使用者寫成三類**（**精算師、保險分析師與養老基金管理人**）；**其最值得記的一處是它把**定價口徑當成一個參數****——**逐字說明公平保費支持**「**基於均值的（**精算中性**）」方法**或**「**基於分位數的**方法，**即把保費加載以在不利情景下保護保險人」**；**第二處是它**單獨給出破產概率****——**逐字說明 `ruin_probability()`「**逐年模擬保險人的資金路徑（加上利息、減去按生存加權的支出）並標記無力償付，**返回以破產收場的模擬情景比例」**；**第三處是它**把隨機性放在最前面****——**逐字說明 `simulate_mortality()` 用**指數改善趨勢（參數 `beta`）**並疊加**標準差為 `sigma` 的高斯衝擊**，**產出 `n_years × n_sim` 的死亡率路徑矩陣**；**⚠️ 而本詞條實測其 `LICENSE` 只有 **246 位元組、7 行**、正文斷在「**in the Software without restriction...**」**——**⭐ 本詞條**據此推斷這正是 GitHub 許可字段報 **NOASSERTION** 的原因**（**⚠️ 該推斷屬本詞條**），**並**如實指出：**README 與 `DESCRIPTION` 都寫著 MIT****
e.summary_en: An R package for longevity risk and annuity analysis, 0 stars, a repository of 18 KB measured at 17 files, describing itself verbatim as a longevity risk and annuity analysis toolkit and naming three kinds of user, actuaries, insurance analysts and pension fund managers. **Its most notable feature is that the pricing basis is a parameter**: verbatim, the fair premium function supports either a mean-based method described as actuarially neutral or a quantile-based method that loads the premium to protect the insurer in adverse scenarios. **The second is that ruin probability is supplied separately**, verbatim by simulating the insurer fund path year by year, adding interest and subtracting survival-weighted payouts, flagging insolvency and returning the proportion of simulated scenarios that end in ruin. **The third puts the stochastic element first**: verbatim, the mortality simulation evolves rates with an exponential improvement trend under a parameter and Gaussian shocks of a given standard deviation, producing a matrix of simulated paths. ⚠️ **And measurement of its licence file finds only 246 bytes across seven lines, with the text stopping mid-sentence inside the permission grant**, ⭐ **from which this entry infers the cause of the NOASSERTION reported by GitHub**, ⚠️ **an inference of this entry**, **and notes plainly that both the readme and the package description say MIT**.
e.body:
**longevity-risk-r**（仓库 `manyagupta-21/longevityRiskR`）**是一份 R 长寿风险与年金分析包**：**逐字自述为**「**Longevity Risk and Annuity Analysis Toolkit**」**，**并逐字说明其面向**「**精算师、保险分析师与养老基金管理人**」**。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可字段为 **NOASSERTION****（**⚠️ 其成因见下，**本词条已实测**）、主语言 R、仓库体量 **18 KB**、**创建 2026-03-25**、最后推送 2026-09-10、无 topics**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**创建与推送**都在解冻窗口之内****）；**README 实测 4,894 字节**；**仓库实测共 **17 个文件、2 个目录**（**经 GitHub API tree 接口实测，`truncated` 为 false；含 `man/` 9 项、`R/` 6 项，**以及 `DESCRIPTION`、`LICENSE`、`NAMESPACE`、`README.md`**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「自证：它拿什么证明自己」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本轮四条里**唯一一条其「自证」**反而暴露出一处不一致**的****。

可核实信息（**均 README、`DESCRIPTION`、`LICENSE` 与 tree 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它把**定价口径**做成一个**可选参数**，并把两个口径各自的性质写明**——**逐字为**：**「**`fair_premium()` supports a **mean**-based (**actuarially neutral**) method or a **quantile**-based method that **loads the premium to protect the insurer in adverse scenarios**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **两个口径并列给出，**且各自带一个性质标签**（**「均值口径＝**精算中性**」与「分位数口径＝**为不利情景加载**」**）**——**⭐ 即**读者一眼看到**同一个「公平保费」在两种口径下不是同一个数**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「精算中性」这个说法被用在**均值口径**上**——**⭐ 本词条认为这一处措辞值得记：**它把「中性」归属于**一种选择**，**而不是**当成默认真理****；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **分位数口径的用途被说成**保护保险人****（**⭐ 即**加载的方向**与**承担者**都写明了**）**；**④ ⭐⭐ **两个口径共用同一个函数名与同一个输出结构**（**逐字给出 `method = "quantile", confidence = 0.95` 的调用与 `premium$summary` 的读法**）**——**⭐ 即**口径是**参数**，**而不是另一个函数**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它把**破产概率**单独做成一个函数，并把算法逐句写出**——**逐字为**：**「**`ruin_probability()` simulates the insurer fund path **year by year** (adding interest, subtracting survival-weighted payouts) and **flags insolvency**, returning the **proportion of simulated scenarios that end in ruin**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **破产的判据、算法与输出三者都写在同一句里**（**现金流怎么走／什么时候算破产／最后返回什么**）**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **破产概率**不是一个附加指标，**而是**与定价并列的一个产出**（**⭐ 逐字给出把定价结果直接喂进去的调用 `ruin_probability(mort_matrix, premium = premium$premium)`**）**——**⭐ 即**「在这个保费下，资金会怎样」**是可算的**；**③ ⭐⭐ **所有输出都带 `$summary`**（**逐字示例中每一步都以 `$summary` 收尾**）**——**⭐ 即**每个函数返回的结构**有约定的摘要入口**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **随机性是第一位的，且参数被具名**——**逐字为**：**「**`simulate_mortality()` evolves mortality rates using an **exponential improvement trend** with a mortality improvement rate `beta`, perturbed by **Gaussian shocks** with standard deviation `sigma`, producing an `n_years × n_sim` **matrix of simulated mortality paths**.」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **模型被写成两个参数**（**`beta` 趋势与 `sigma` 冲击**）**——**⭐ 即**随机性的来源**可被读者精确指出**；**② ⭐⭐ **输出形状被写明**（**`n_years × n_sim`**）**——**⭐ 即**下游函数吃什么**是明确的**；**③ ⭐⭐ **确定性路径只是随机矩阵的一个特例**（**逐字另有一个 `annuity_pv()` 从单条死亡率向量算现值**）**——**⭐ 即**「确定性」与「随机」不是两套代码**。**④ ⭐⭐ **它的功能表、包结构与文档件数都可核实**——**逐字给出 **8 个函数**及其用途**（**随机死亡率模拟／确定性年金现值／随机年金现值分布／公平或含风险加载的保费／生存概率／余命／破产概率／年金现值分布图**）**；**逐字给出包结构**（**`R/mortality.R`、`R/annuity.R`、`R/survival.R`、`R/risk.R`、`R/visualisation.R`，**外加 `man/`、`DESCRIPTION`、`NAMESPACE`、`LICENSE`**）**；**实测 `R/` 下 **6 项**、`man/` 下 **9 项**——**⭐ 即**文档与源码**一函数一档**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **安装方式与联系方式逐字给出**（**逐字 `remotes::install_github(...)`，**并给出作者姓名、一处 LinkedIn 与一处院校邮箱**）**。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[mortalitylaws]]、[[stmomo]]、[[lifecontingencies]]、[[pylifecontingencies]]、[[cvmortalitymult]]、[[hmdhfdplus]]、[[mortcast]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **一处**许可正文不完整**是本条最重要的一处，且是本词条实测所得****：**其 `LICENSE` 文件**实测只有 **246 字节、7 行**，**首行是 `MIT License`、第三行是版权行，**而**正文在「**in the Software without restriction...**」处**以一个字面的三点省略号结束****——**即**它看起来是一份 MIT，**而**实际是一份**被截断的许可文本**（**⭐ 本站此前记录过「有声明无文件」「无任何声明」「自定义非 OSI」「两份并列导致 NOASSERTION」等形态，**而**「**声明是 MIT、文件却是残篇**」是**新的一种****）**；**⭐ 而其 `DESCRIPTION` 逐字写着 `License: MIT + file LICENSE`，**README 亦逐字写着「MIT © 2026 Manya Gupta」**（**⭐ 即**声明在**两处**，**而**文件本身**不足以支撑该声明**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 本词条**据此推断**：**GitHub 许可字段报 **NOASSERTION**，**正是因为该文件**无法被识别为完整的 MIT 文本**（**⚠️ 这是**本词条的解读**，**不是 GitHub 的说明**；**本词条**未查 GitHub 的许可识别逻辑**）**。**⭐⭐ 三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **声明与文件可以**互相矛盾**（**此处**文件短于声明**）；**② ⭐⭐ **这种矛盾**机器能看出来而人容易看漏**（**⭐ 因为**README 与 `DESCRIPTION` 两处都写得**干净利落****）；**③ ⭐⭐ **使用前应打开许可文件本身**（**⭐ 本词条**据此重申：**许可字段、README 里的许可节与许可文件**是**三个不同的东西**，**而**本轮的主题恰好是「自证」——**一份被截断的许可**是**自证失败的最直接例子****）。**② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **本次**没有安装或运行它的任何一步****——**未安装 R、未 `remotes::install_github`、未跑 `simulate_mortality()`／`stochastic_annuity()`／`fair_premium()`／`ruin_probability()`、未打开任何 `.Rd` 文档、未生成其图**；**故**本词条**不主张**其随机模拟、其年金定价、其两个保费口径或其次破产概率**按其所述工作**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README、`DESCRIPTION` 与 `LICENSE` 的**逐字内容**（**含字节数与行数**），**与其经 tree 接口实测的文件结构**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读其任何 R 源码****（**⭐ 即**未核对**指数改善趋势与高斯冲击是否确实按所述实现、**分位数口径是否确实按 `confidence = 0.95` 取分位、**以及**破产判定是否确实只按资金路径**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其模型在精算意义上是否合适**（**⭐ 其死亡率的**指数改善趋势＋高斯冲击**是一个**简化模型**——**⭐ 本词条**如实指出这一点，**⚠️ 但**不主张**它比 [[stmomo]] 一类的随机死亡率模型差**，**因为**本词条**未做任何比较**）。**⑤ ⭐ ⚠️ **一处**形态密度**如实记录**：**本站已收多条**年金／长寿**方向的条目**（**`lifecontingencies`／`pylifecontingencies`／`lifecontingencies-jl`／`detlifeinsurance`／`longevity`／`mortalitylaws`／`stmomo` 等**）**——**⭐ 本词条**指出本条与之**不同的地方在于**它把**破产概率**与**保费口径**放在同一个包内**（**⭐ 而**这一点**正是它入选的理由****）。**⑥ ⚠️ **★0、fork 0、无 topics**，**且**未核实作者背景**（**⭐ 其 `DESCRIPTION` 与 README 的署名一致，**联系方式为院校邮箱**）。**⑦ ⚠️ **版本号为 `0.0.0.1`**（**⭐ 实测 `DESCRIPTION` 逐字如此**）**——**⭐ 本词条**如实记录**：**这是一个**极早期的版本号****。**⑧ ⚠️ **创建与推送均在解冻窗口之内（2026-03-25／2026-09-10）****。**⑨ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/manyagupta-21/longevityRiskR` 于 2026-09-11 经仓库检索接口与 GitHub API 实测读取（★数、许可字段 NOASSERTION、语言、体量、创建／推送时间）；README 4,894 字节、`DESCRIPTION` 全文与 `LICENSE` 全文经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对（**`LICENSE` 实测 **246 字节／7 行**，**末尾为字面的三点省略号****）；`LICENSE` 的存在经 raw 探测确认（HTTP 200）；**文件清单经 GitHub API tree 接口实测（17 个文件、2 个目录，`truncated` 为 false）**；**未克隆、未安装 R 或任何包、未运行任何函数、未生成任何图、未打开任何 `.Rd` 文档、未做其他网络观察**。

可核實資訊（**均 README、`DESCRIPTION`、`LICENSE` 與 tree 實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它把**定價口徑**做成一個**可選參數**，並把兩個口徑各自的性質寫明**——**逐字「**`fair_premium()` supports a **mean**-based (**actuarially neutral**) method or a **quantile**-based method that **loads the premium to protect the insurer in adverse scenarios**.」**⭐⭐⭐ 四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐兩個口徑並列給出，且各自帶一個性質標籤**（「均值口徑＝**精算中性**」與「分位數口徑＝**為不利情景加載**」——讀者一眼看到**同一個「公平保費」在兩種口徑下不是同一個數**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐「精算中性」被用在**均值口徑**上**（把「中性」歸屬於**一種選擇**，而不是當成默認真理）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐分位數口徑的用途被說成**保護保險人**（加載的方向與承擔者都寫明了）；**④ ⭐⭐兩個口徑共用同一函數名與同一輸出結構**（逐字給出 `method = "quantile", confidence = 0.95` 的調用與 `premium$summary` 的讀法——口徑是**參數**，而不是另一個函數）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **把**破產概率**單獨做成一個函數，並把算法逐句寫出**——逐字「**`ruin_probability()` simulates the insurer fund path year by year (adding interest, subtracting survival-weighted payouts) and flags insolvency, returning the proportion of simulated scenarios that end in ruin.**」**三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐破產的判據、算法與輸出三者寫在同一句裡**；**② ⭐⭐⭐破產概率不是附加指標，而是與定價並列的一個產出**（逐字給出把定價結果直接餵進去的調用 `ruin_probability(mort_matrix, premium = premium$premium)`——「在這個保費下，資金會怎樣」是可算的）；**③ ⭐⭐所有輸出都帶 `$summary`**（每個函數返回的結構有約定的摘要入口）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **隨機性是第一位的，且參數被具名**——逐字「**`simulate_mortality()` evolves mortality rates using an exponential improvement trend with a mortality improvement rate `beta`, perturbed by Gaussian shocks with standard deviation `sigma`, producing an `n_years × n_sim` matrix of simulated mortality paths.**」**三處**：**① ⭐⭐模型被寫成兩個參數**（`beta` 趨勢與 `sigma` 衝擊——隨機性的來源可被讀者精確指出）；**② **longevity-risk-r** (repository `manyagupta-21/longevityRiskR`) **is an R package for longevity risk and annuity analysis**, describing itself verbatim as a longevity risk and annuity analysis toolkit and naming its users verbatim as actuaries, insurance analysts and pension fund managers. **Measured 0 stars, 0 forks, a licence field of NOASSERTION** — ⚠️ whose cause is measured below — **primary language R, an 18 KB repository, created 2026-03-25, last pushed 2026-09-10, with no topics** (all GitHub API measurements; ⭐ **creation and push both inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 4,894 bytes**; **the repository measures 17 files and 2 directories**, read through the trees endpoint with truncation false, being six R files, nine manual pages and a description, licence, namespace and readme. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **self-verification**, and ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it is the one whose self-description turns out to contain an inconsistency**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README, the package description, the licence file and the measured tree**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① It makes the pricing basis a selectable parameter and states the character of each basis** — verbatim, the fair premium function supports a mean-based method described as actuarially neutral **or a quantile-based method that loads the premium to protect the insurer in adverse scenarios** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the two bases are given side by side, each with a character label, so a reader sees at once that one fair premium is not the same number under two bases**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the phrase actuarially neutral is attached to the mean basis**, ⭐ **which this entry records as worth noting, since neutrality is attributed to one of two choices rather than treated as the default truth**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the purpose of the quantile basis is stated as protecting the insurer, so both the direction of the loading and who bears it are given**; **and ⭐⭐ the two bases share one function name and one output structure**, the readme giving the call with a method and confidence argument and the way the summary is read, ⭐ **so the basis is a parameter rather than a second function**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ Ruin probability is a function of its own and its algorithm is spelled out sentence by sentence** — verbatim, the function simulates the insurer fund path **year by year**, adding interest and subtracting survival-weighted payouts, **flags insolvency and returns the proportion of simulated scenarios that end in ruin** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the criterion, the algorithm and the output all sit in one sentence**, namely how the cash flows move, when insolvency counts and what is returned; ⭐⭐⭐ **ruin probability is not a supplementary metric but an output standing beside the pricing**, the readme giving a call that feeds the priced premium straight in, ⭐ **so what happens to the fund under that premium is computable**; **and ⭐⭐ every output carries a summary entry point**, each step in the quick start ending that way. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The stochastic element comes first and its parameters are named** — verbatim, the simulation evolves mortality rates using an exponential improvement trend under an improvement-rate parameter, perturbed by Gaussian shocks of a given standard deviation, **producing a matrix of simulated mortality paths** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **the model reduces to two parameters, a trend and a shock size, so a reader can point exactly at where the randomness comes from**; ⭐⭐ **the shape of the output is given, so what the downstream functions consume is unambiguous**; **and ⭐⭐ the deterministic path is only a special case of the stochastic matrix**, a separate function computing a present value from a single mortality vector, ⭐ **so deterministic and stochastic are not two code bases**. **④ ⭐⭐ Its function table, package structure and document count are all verifiable** — eight functions with their purposes are given verbatim, from stochastic mortality simulation through deterministic and stochastic annuity valuation, fair or risk-loaded premiums, survival probability, life expectancy and ruin probability to a distribution plot; **the package structure is given verbatim** as five R files plus manual pages, description, namespace and licence; **and measurement finds six entries under the R directory and nine under the manual directory**, ⭐ **one document per function**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ Installation and contact details are given verbatim**, an install command plus an author name, a profile link and an institutional email address. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Readable with** [[mortalitylaws]], [[stmomo]], [[lifecontingencies]], [[pylifecontingencies]], [[cvmortalitymult]], [[hmdhfdplus]] and [[mortcast]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ An incomplete licence text is the most important point in this entry, and it was measured here**: **the licence file measures only 246 bytes across seven lines**, its first line reading MIT License and its third the copyright line, **while the body stops mid-sentence inside the permission grant on a literal three-dot ellipsis** — **so it looks like an MIT licence but is in fact a truncated licence text**, ⭐ **and this entry notes that where this site has previously recorded a claim with no file, no statement at all, a custom non-open-source licence and two licences in parallel leading to NOASSERTION, a claim of MIT backed by a fragment is a new shape**; **its package description states verbatim that the licence is MIT with a licence file, and the readme states verbatim MIT with a year and an author, so the claim appears in two places while the file itself is not sufficient to support it**. ⭐⭐⭐ **This entry infers that the NOASSERTION reported by GitHub arises precisely because the file cannot be recognised as complete MIT text**, ⚠️ **an interpretation by this entry rather than a statement by GitHub**, the licence-detection logic not having been examined. ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **a claim and a file can contradict each other, here the file being shorter than the claim**; ⭐⭐ **such a contradiction is easier for a machine to see than for a person, since both the readme and the description read cleanly**; **and ⭐⭐ the licence file itself should be opened before use**, ⭐ **the entry restating that a licence field, a licence section in a readme and a licence file are three different things, and that a truncated licence is the most direct example of self-verification failing**. **② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ Nothing in it was installed or run** — **R was not installed, the install command was not run, none of the simulation, valuation, premium or ruin functions was called, no manual page was opened and no plot was produced**; **so this entry does not claim its stochastic simulation, its annuity valuation, its two premium bases or its ruin probability work as described**, ⭐ **what it verified being the verbatim readme, package description and licence file, including byte and line counts, and the file structure measured through the trees endpoint**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No R source was read**, ⭐ **so whether the exponential improvement trend and Gaussian shocks are implemented as described, whether the quantile basis really takes the stated quantile, and whether insolvency is really judged only from the fund path were not checked**. **④ ⚠️ Whether the model is actuarially appropriate was not verified** — ⭐ **its exponential improvement trend under Gaussian shocks is a simplified model, which this entry states plainly**, ⚠️ **while making no claim that it is worse than a stochastic mortality model of the kind recorded elsewhere on this site, no comparison having been made**. **⑤ ⭐ ⚠️ The density of this form is recorded plainly**: this site already holds several annuity and longevity entries, ⭐ **and what distinguishes this one is that it places ruin probability and the premium basis inside a single package, which is the reason it was collected**. **⑥ ⚠️ At 0 stars with no forks and no topics the author’s background was not verified**, ⭐ **the description and readme agreeing on the name and giving an institutional address**. **⑦ ⚠️ The version number is 0.0.0.1** as measured in the description, ⭐ **an extremely early version number, recorded as such**. **⑧ ⚠️ Creation and push both fall inside the thaw window**. **⑨ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11**. **Verification note**: the repository was read on 2026-09-11 through the repository search endpoint and the GitHub API for stars, licence field, language, size and dates; the 4,894-byte readme, the full package description and the full licence file were read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim, **the licence measuring 246 bytes across seven lines and ending on a literal three-dot ellipsis**; the licence file’s existence was confirmed by a raw probe returning 200; **the file listing was read through the trees endpoint, 17 files and 2 directories with truncation false**; **nothing was cloned, R and no package were installed, no function was run, no plot was produced, no manual page was opened, and no other network observation was made**.
